name: ss33
description: ss33 Skill Store: harness-agnostic core + CLI, with Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Cursor and GitHub Copilot plugin adapters

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle && npm run sync:codex && npm run sync:hermes && npm run sync:cursor && npm run sync:copilot
scripts.sync:codex: cp adapters/claude-code/lib/ss33.cjs adapters/codex/lib/ss33.cjs && cp adapters/claude-code/scripts/ss33 adapters/codex/scripts/ss33
scripts.sync:hermes: mkdir -p adapters/hermes/lib adapters/hermes/scripts && cp adapters/claude-code/lib/ss33.cjs adapters/hermes/lib/ss33.cjs && cp adapters/claude-code/scripts/ss33 adapters/hermes/scripts/ss33
scripts.sync:cursor: mkdir -p adapters/cursor/lib adapters/cursor/scripts && cp adapters/claude-code/lib/ss33.cjs adapters/cursor/lib/ss33.cjs && cp adapters/claude-code/scripts/ss33 adapters/cursor/scripts/ss33
scripts.sync:copilot: mkdir -p adapters/copilot/lib adapters/copilot/scripts && cp adapters/claude-code/lib/ss33.cjs adapters/copilot/lib/ss33.cjs && cp adapters/claude-code/scripts/ss33 adapters/copilot/scripts/ss33
